question: What is the difference between the ADD and COPY Dockerfile instructions? (Choose two.) A. ADD supports regular expression handling while COPY does not. B. COPY supports compression format handling while ADD does not. C. ADD supports compression format handling while COPY does not. D. COPY supports regular expression handling while ADD does not. E.
